_comment: Copy to .mcp.json (gitignored). Also copy .grok.example.toml to .grok/config.toml and .codex.example.toml to .codex/config.toml so Grok and Codex do not fall through to a personal generic pwsh_exec. PERL_ROOT is the portable Strawberry Perl root; PERL_HOME is derived by scripts/profile.ps1. MCP_POWERSHELL_PROFILE must be this checkout's scripts/profile.ps1. Do not set tool_timeout_sec on pwsh_exec here: child scripts own WaitTimeoutSeconds. pwsh_exec command is the owned CPython under mcp/pwsh_exec/deps/python (restore writes the concrete path); uv.exe is restore-only.
